poll_note: The feed's metaData.wait asks for 10 s. Measured on 849844 (2026-10-02): a pitch reaches the feed about 11 s after it is thrown, then waits for our next fetch. fast_poll_s applies only while a viewer whose broadcast delay is under fast_poll_below_delay_s is watching (plan CP4).
display_note: PROVISIONAL, not a validated limit. feed_lag_delayed_s: a served snapshot whose newest game event was still missing from a good poll made more than this many seconds after it (the proven minimum lag) puts the fan screen in the feed_delayed display state (display_state.py). 45 is a first guess above the lag seen on one live game (849844, 2026-10-02: median about 19 s); revisit after the replay rehearsal. Env PITCHEEZY_OBSERVER_FEED_LAG_DELAYED_S overrides.
zone_bounds_source: League median sz_bot/sz_top of data/raw/d20260911-s2325 statcast_2023-2025 rows with game_date <= 2025-04-30 (bundle training_cutoff), n=1567136. Not batter-specific; the live feed's 2026 strikeZoneTop/Bottom are deliberately ignored.
features_source: Frozen bundle metadata.json pins only: pitchers, profiles (profile_cutoff 2025-04-30), default_profile (league row, zero reliability), repertoire_counts.
